sentences.en: OK Rosie, shall we try to get some ideas together for our presentation on diet and obesity?
sentences.zh: OK Rosie，我们来一起为关于饮食和肥胖的演讲想些点子吧？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I can talk about the experiment I did to see if people can tell the difference between real sugar and artificial sweeteners.
sentences.zh: 我可以讲讲我做的一个实验，看看人们能否分辨出真正的糖和人工甜味剂。

sentences.en: Where you gave people drinks with either sugar or artificial sweeteners and they had to say which they thought it was?
sentences.zh: 就是你给人们喝含糖或人工甜味剂的饮料，然后让他们判断自己喝的是哪一种？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It took me ages to decide exactly how I'd organise it, especially how I could make sure that people didn't know which drink I was giving them.
sentences.zh: 我花了很长时间才确定实验的具体组织方式，尤其是如何确保受试者不知道我给他们喝的是哪种饮料。

sentences.en: It was hard to / keep track of it all, especially as I had so many people doing it- I had to make / sure I kept a proper record of what each person had had.
sentences.zh: 全程跟踪记录很困难，特别是因为参与人数太多——我必须确保准确记录每个人所喝饮料的种类。

sentences.en: So could most people tell the difference?
sentences.zh: 那么，大多数人能分辨出区别吗？

sentences.en: Yeah-I hadn't thought they would be able to, but most people could.
sentences.zh: 能——我原本以为他们分辨不出来，但结果大多数人都能。

sentences.en: Then there's that experiment I did measuring the fat content of nuts, to see if the nutritional information given on the packet was accurate.
sentences.zh: 另外，我还做过一个实验，测量坚果的脂肪含量，以检验包装上标注的营养信息是否准确。

sentences.en: The one where you ground up the nuts and mixed them with a chemical to absorb the fat?
sentences.zh: 就是把坚果研磨后，再与一种吸收脂肪的化学试剂混合的那个实验？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My results were a bit problematic- the fat content for that type of nut seemed much lower than it said on the package.
sentences.zh: 我的实验结果有点问题——这种坚果测得的脂肪含量明显低于包装上所标示的数值。

sentences.en: But I reckon the package information was right.
sentences.zh: 但我认为包装上的信息是正确的。

sentences.en: I think l should probably have around up the nuts more than I did.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我本应该比实际做的更充分地把坚果碾碎。

sentences.en: It's possible that the scales for weighing the fat weren't accurate enough, too.
sentences.zh: 用来称量脂肪的秤的精度可能也不够高。

sentences.en: I'd really like to try the experiment again some time.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想找个时间再做一次这个实验。

sentences.en: ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： / / So what can we say about helping people to lose weight?
sentences.zh: ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： ADAM： ROSIE： / / 那么，关于帮助人们减肥，我们能说些什么呢？

sentences.en: There's a lot we could say about what restaurants could do to reduce obesity.
sentences.zh: 关于餐厅可以采取哪些措施来减少肥胖问题，我们可以谈的有很多。

sentences.en: I read that the items at the start of a menu and the items at the end of a menu are much more likely to be chosen than the items in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我读到过，菜单开头和结尾处的菜品被选中的概率远高于中间部分的菜品。

sentences.en: So, if you put the low-calorie items at the beginning and end of the menu, people will probably go for the food with fewer calories, without even realising what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你把低热量菜品放在菜单的开头和结尾，人们就很可能选择热量更低的食物，甚至根本意识不到自己在这样做。

sentences.en: I think food manufacturers could do more to encourage healthy eating.
sentences.zh: 我认为食品制造商可以在鼓励健康饮食方面做得更多。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, when manufacturers put calorie counts of a food on the label, they're sometimes really confusing and I suspect they do it on purpose.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当制造商在标签上标注食品的卡路里含量时，有时这些信息非常令人困惑，我怀疑他们是有意为之。

sentences.en: Because food that's high in calories tastes better, and so they'll sell more.
sentences.zh: 因为高热量食品味道更好，所以销量会更高。
